note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_journal.py; type=manual require agent/render/practitioner inspection.

GATE_1_specification.text: Trademark/risk screen reported; title clear or flagged
Tier classified and justified; risk regime assigned (R0 / R1-R4)
Dated/undated confirmed; undated unless operator declared otherwise
Every field, label, line count, checkbox of every unit; repetition count with arithmetic; all special pages listed
Trim size, margins/gutter, page total, and typography tier (standard vs large print) stated
Working subtitle from 6-8 options; title+subtitle <=200 chars; subtitle 50-150 chars
Repetition-count arithmetic yields a page total inside the tier's KDP page band
Accent scheme selected and verified unique against the catalogue
Message ends with Type Proceed; nothing generated past the gate

GATE_2_unit_approval.text: Master repeating unit rendered exactly to spec; all labels verbatim from approved spec
Subject-Matter Practitioner review of every field against the real task; fields added/deleted as needed
Line spacing physically writable for the audience (adult 0.28-0.32 in; senior/child >=0.5 in)
Response spaces sized to expected answers
Tier 3: full prompt list reviewed - no duplicates, arc verified, regime-compliant; R3-R4 framing and crisis-resource page present
Tables and rules are native Word objects; no underscores-as-lines
Content-standards and em-dash ban verified across all labels and prompts

GATE_3_assembly.text: Page-system walkthrough audit: simulate 7 consecutive days/entries of real use; any friction is a blocking correction
Left/right roles consistent book-wide; first unit lands on correct verso/recto after front matter; two-page units never split; repetition-count parity verified
Spot-check units at start, middle, end - structurally identical
Repetition-count arithmetic matches the delivered page total; total within KDP limits for the trim
Front matter order correct; copyright/disclaimer tuned to tier and regime; author name in house format
Dated content absent (or correct, if a dated edition was declared)
Reference pages accurate to current guidelines (medical logs)

GATE_4_release.text: Final PDF preflight at exact trim; margins and gutter pass KDP preflight; no live elements outside safe area
Undated status, page count, and trim in subtitle/description match the actual interior
Cover spine width computed for the final page count and paper color
Trademark findings re-confirmed against final title, subtitle, and cover text
R3-R4: crisis-resource page present in required positions; no therapeutic claims anywhere in book or metadata
Catalogue uniqueness confirmed (scheme, cover treatment, unit design differ from all prior titles)
Content-standards and em-dash sweeps re-run on the final build
